command: gamemode adventure
effect: Tries to set every player to adventure; fails (no player context).
risk_1_21: No syntax break, but still a no-op in 1.21.1: command block executes as the server, not a player. Multiverse/server gamemode applies (survival on the review server), so the build is breakable.

command: /gamemode adventure
effect: Same as above, with leading slash.
risk_1_21: Same no-op in 1.21.1; Multiverse/server gamemode applies.

command: enchant @a minecraft:unbreaking 3
effect: Enchants the item in each player's main hand with Unbreaking III.
notes: Runs every tick; re-applies after item swaps.

command: enchant @a minecraft:riptide
effect: Enchants the held item with Riptide I.

command: execute as @a at @s if block ~ ~-1 ~ yellow_glazed_terracotta run setworldspawn
effect: Any yellow glazed pad under any player sets the GLOBAL world spawn there.
risk_1_21: Valid in 1.21.1; global spawn semantics unchanged.
notes: Turns every yellow speed pad into a checkpoint (H).
